# moddotplot-interactive v0.8.2

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.8.2 improves the plot workspace at narrower browser sizes and makes the relationship
between matrix resolution and genomic scale explicit. These interface changes do not
alter the estimator or the numeric contents of generated matrix cells.

See the [validation record](v0.8.2/VALIDATION.md) for the completed local verification
evidence.

## Responsive plot-header layout

The plot header now preserves space between the **Clear** control and the rendered plot
as the browser window is narrowed or resized. The control remains usable without being
compressed into, clipped by, or visually merged with the plot surface.

## Resolution and genomic window size

Advanced options now labels the existing matrix-dimension setting **Plot resolution**.
This describes the number of cells used to render the plot rather than the amount of
sequence represented by an individual cell.

A new read-only **Plot window size** value appears directly below it. The value reports
the genomic interval represented by each matrix cell at the current zoom level, allowing
users to relate plot resolution to genomic scale without changing the estimator
configuration. It updates after zoom and reset. If the shared genomic domain is not
evenly divisible, the readout shows the exact pair of possible integer window widths;
grid mode reports that the value varies until an individual comparison is opened.
